extracted.intended_audience: public relations professionals and PR agencies using AI for PR
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and prompt examples for using ChatGPT (and Prowly AI) to draft press releases, media pitches, crisis communications, research summaries, content ideas, and PR measurement reports. Emphasizes prompt technique, safety, and editorial refinements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Perform fact checking
rubrics_metrics.description: Perform fact checking before using the content generated by ChatGPT.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify the accuracy of AI-generated content to prevent the spread of false information; have humans verify reliability to make sure it's legit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prioritize data security
rubrics_metrics.description: Prioritize data security when using AI tools.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid sharing any confidential client information in ChatGPT because user input can be used to improve models and may later be shared; protect sensitive data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use conversational, iterative prompting
rubrics_metrics.description: Use a conversational flow and iterative prompts rather than trying to craft one perfect prompt.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep the conversation moving until satisfied, ask the AI what it needs (e.g., 'I want to write a press release about X, what do you need to know to help me?'), then tweak responses interactively.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expect drafts and require human editing
rubrics_metrics.description: Expect ChatGPT output to be a draft version, not a finished press release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even with the best prompts you'll likely obtain a draft; apply human touch, editing, and refinement before using content live.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid jargon, buzzwords, and generic phrasing
rubrics_metrics.description: Avoid jargon, buzzwords, and generic phrases in press releases generated by AI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Journalists tend to be 'allergic' to these; add a personal touch and a unique human voice to improve media uptake.

rubrics_metrics.name: Product launch press release structure
rubrics_metrics.description: For product launches: highlight key features, benefits, and significance on the market.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prompt example: 'Help me craft a press release announcing the launch of our new product, [product name]. The release should highlight its key features, benefits, and its significance on the market.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Company milestone press release structure
rubrics_metrics.description: For company milestones (e.g., anniversaries): showcase achievements, growth, and industry impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prompt example: 'Create a press release to celebrate our company's 10th anniversary. Showcase our achievements, growth, and the impact we've made in the industry over the past decade.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Partnership announcement press release structure
rubrics_metrics.description: For partnership announcements: emphasize synergy between organizations and benefits to clients.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prompt example: 'Draft a press release to announce our strategic partnership with [partner's name]. Emphasize the synergy between our organizations and the benefits this partnership will bring to our clients.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Event press release structure
rubrics_metrics.description: For events: highlight the agenda, guest speakers, and why it's a must-attend.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prompt example: 'Assist me in writing a press release for our upcoming industry event. Highlight the event's agenda, guest speakers, and why it's a must-attend for professionals in our field.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Research report press release structure
rubrics_metrics.description: For research reports: summarize key findings, statistics, and insights to pique media interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prompt example: 'Create a press release to promote our latest research report on [topic]. Summarize key findings, statistics, and insights.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Tailor media pitches to specific outlets
rubrics_metrics.description: Customize media pitches to the outlet and its audience, highlighting relevance and unique angles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include tailored email pitches to TechCrunch, Vogue, NYT etc.; emphasize product uniqueness and relevance to the outlet's readers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crisis response plan structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Create a step-by-step crisis response plan that addresses stakeholder communication and reputation repair.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include strategies for addressing the issue, communicating with stakeholders, and steps for reputation repair; use iterative prompts to refine tone and sequencing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data breach communication requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: In a data breach, outline notification steps, coordination with authorities, and trust restoration measures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prompt example: 'Create a comprehensive communication plan for our organization in the event of a data breach. Outline steps to notify affected parties, coordinate with authorities, and restore customer trust.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Product recall messaging
rubrics_metrics.description: Craft messaging for product recalls covering communications to customers, media, and regulators to minimize brand damage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detail how to communicate with affected customers, the media, and regulatory agencies; include templates and sequencing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Employee misconduct communications
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop internal and external communication strategy for employee misconduct incidents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include internal communication steps and external messaging that mitigate reputational risk while being transparent and compliant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural disaster response communications
rubrics_metrics.description: Plan communications for natural disasters that ensure employee safety and business continuity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Outline how to ensure employee safety, communicate with the public, and maintain operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Generate engaging content ideas
rubrics_metrics.description: Use AI to brainstorm engaging PR content, trending topics, social media posts, and interactive content ideas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prompt examples: 'Generate ideas for engaging PR content related to [client/industry].' 'Suggest social media post ideas' 'Help us brainstorm interactive content such as quizzes.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Research and competitor intelligence
rubrics_metrics.description: Use AI to summarize industry trends, list reputable sources, compile competitors, and identify events to attend.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prompt examples include 'Provide a summary of the latest industry trends and statistics', 'Generate a list of reputable sources', and 'Compile a list of key competitors and their PR strategies.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Templates for measurement and reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Create templates for monthly PR performance reports including key metrics and insights.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prompt example: 'Create a template for monthly PR performance reports, including key metrics and insights.' Include suggested sections and data visualizations where relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-campaign evaluation checklist
rubrics_metrics.description: Produce a checklist for post-campaign PR evaluations with lessons learned and improvement areas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include steps for collecting outcomes, documenting lessons learned, and recommending next steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tools and sentiment monitoring
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify tools and software for monitoring and analyzing media coverage and sentiment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prompt example: 'Generate a list of tools and software for monitoring and analyzing media coverage and sentiment.' Include pros/cons and recommended use cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Framework for crisis measurement
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a framework for measuring crisis management effectiveness, including reputation recovery metrics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include metrics and timeframes for assessing reputation recovery and restoration of stakeholder trust.

rubrics_metrics.name: KPIs for product launch PR and measurement guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Suggest KPIs to track for product launch PR campaigns and explain how to measure them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: media mentions, share of voice, website traffic, conversions; explain data sources and measurement methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: No single 'best' prompt — adapt prompts to situation
rubrics_metrics.description: There are no universally best ChatGPT prompts for writing press releases; prompts must be adapted to the specific story and goals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use provided prompts as starting points; follow-up prompts depend on desired outcomes and communication goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: AI limitations for editing and text-surgery
rubrics_metrics.description: ChatGPT is not ideal as a precise text editor for cutting/changing only specific parts of longer texts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: It works well for short social posts; for longer texts you may get lost in changes and end up copy-pasting between apps—plan for additional editing effort.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethical introduction of AI in PR
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduce AI solutions in PR ethically.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure ethical considerations are addressed when implementing AI in agencies (e.g., transparency, accuracy, client consent).

rubrics_metrics.name: Prowly AI input selection workflow
rubrics_metrics.description: When using Prowly AI: select target audience, press release type, language, and tone of voice before generation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prowly then generates in-depth, journalist-mirroring questions to produce a higher-quality, unique story without requiring manual prompt crafting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use AI to identify journalists and craft pitches
rubrics_metrics.description: Use AI to suggest journalists that might be interested in your story and to create email subject lines and previews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Integrated tools can recommend contacts and help compose pitches, reducing the need to switch tools and copy-paste content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrated workflow reduces friction and improves quality
rubrics_metrics.description: An all-in-one AI workflow (ideation, editing, journalist discovery, sending) reduces copying/pasting and distraction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This seamless process aims to produce a thorough draft that is easier to refine, improving final quality and saving time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treat AI output as a creative starting point
rubrics_metrics.description: Use AI-generated drafts as a solid base to edit, refine, or spark new ideas rather than as finished copy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You have the freedom to edit for uniqueness and journalistic suitability; AI-generated content should be personalized and humanized before distribution.
